description: Ministry of Defence - Award the Prashansaneeya Seva Vibhushanaya & Seva Padakkama to the Naval Personnel.
categorisation: This gazette announces awards (Prashansaneeya Seva Vibhushanaya and Prashansaneeya Seva Padakkama) to naval personnel, which falls under public service recognition and honors. While it involves military personnel, the core content is about service awards and recognition rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments with portfolios, or specialized categories like land or legal matters. This aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) which covers public sector service conditions, benefits, and recognitions.
